row: Hi I'm Sara. I am a professional Equine Sports Massage Therapist working in Wiltshire, Hampshire, Somerset and Dorset. As part of my work I take videos of horses walking and trotting and slow them down using the SloMo app on my iPad. This helps me understand where the horse isn't moving correctly and where it may have aches and pains. I can then perform a full body massage on the horse and explain to the owner how the horse can be rehabilitated and restore full movement to the affected area(s). I always massage the whole of the horse as all the muscles are interlinked and compensate for the movement of each other and it is pointless working on one muscle just for another to become sore.
